proposedContributions.change: Wrap the existing Tiptap host, not a new editor. Consume accepted descriptor/ref/revision/epoch/source identity and retained source. Project supported editor transactions to reviewed raw-span patches keyed by stable block identity; preserve unsupported regions and raw bytes. Coordinate durable draft append before send, per-sequence ACK reconciliation/readback, late-result fencing, explicit compare/rebase, restore result adoption and tagged save states. Declare schema-versioned history/preview/restore request/result/error boundaries with all eight required failure discriminants and consume the same schemas at the approved server boundary.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: FG-HISTORY-SERVER-BOUNDARY, FG-DRAFT-PERSISTENCE-IDENTITY, accepted LSX-WP-003/-005/-006; FG-COLLABORATION for shared operations. Tiptap transaction-to-byte mapping is new work, not already provided by retained-source.ts.

proposedContributions.change: RD-08 drawer in the existing Notes surface: authorized cursor timeline with author/source/revision/time, readonly preview/diff, explicit confirmation against current aggregate revision and epoch. Restore invokes the real native authority, then adopts its committed receipt/readback as a new history entry. Loading/empty/denied/deleted/conflict/offline states retain permitted draft, cancel performs no mutation, Escape returns focus without remounting the editor.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Authenticated history permission/snapshot/restore service and common locale integration. Never call NativeNotesEngine.importVault to restore the live document.

proposedContributions.change: Versioned DocumentDraft journal logic over the integration-approved real durable adapter, not a content authority. Key by trusted actor/account/workspace/canonical ref/sourceStoreId/authorityEpoch and device session where required. Persist retained base hash/bytes, base revision, sequence, pending raw-span intents and exact operationId before network send. ACK atomically retires only the matching sequence/operation/source/epoch; newer edits remain. Unknown outcomes replay the identical command, never a fresh ID. Recover incompatible/corrupt/quota states without deleting unacked bytes; quarantine revoked drafts under policy. Shared operations reference the existing collaboration WAL rather than duplicate it.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Real adapter and authenticated scope supplied under FG-DRAFT-PERSISTENCE-IDENTITY. Adapter interfaces alone would be incomplete implementation.

proposedContributions.change: Behavioral cases for crash before send/ACK, lost ACK and identical replay, ACK of sequence N while N+1 remains, cross-actor/workspace/source isolation, stale epoch/revision, denied historic snapshots, same-body restore audit identity, old snapshot immutability, exact byte/hash readback after real authority restart and seeded draft-clear/history-overwrite mutants. Retain deterministic seeds and exact tested artifact digests; use actual native temporary owner persistence, not mock forwarding assertions.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Accepted backend/adapter seams; implementation phase only. Not created or run during this preflight.

risks: Live root integration may invalidate hashes/line ranges; evidence is current at capture, not pinned to a product implementation commit.

A renderer-only patch cannot satisfy durable journal, authenticated history/restore or revoke requirements; current writable packet omits required native transport/server and locale integration paths.
Hardcoded authorityEpoch:1 in the inspected save seam is not the resolved descriptor epoch; stale-epoch operations must reject before rebase.

Existing serializer and frontmatter helper normalize persisted bytes. Raw-span primitives do not supply editor-to-source mapping automatically, and NativeNotesEngine stamping cannot replace the retained authority.
Delayed ACK/unknown response handling must survive restart and preserve newer draft sequences; current in-memory pending map loses identity on crash.

Content-hash revision tokens repeat when restored content repeats. New immutable/auditable revision-entry identity and its aggregate CAS compatibility need authority-owner resolution before implementation.
History preview/restore must check present snapshot permissions and never revive old ACL/private comments or leak cached source/asset content.

Private comments localStorage is noteId-only and writes during add; it is neither a scoped draft journal nor common shared discussions. Migration is another owner/package gate, not automatic publication.

Published specifications contain broader Drive/common messaging and shared-document conformance dependencies absent from the three explicit LSX edges. They remain separate gates, not invented extra dependency entries or silently waived acceptance.
Native commit changed callback acceptance proves local invalidation handoff only, not remote ACK/delivery/convergence. Collaboration/presence cannot be simulated from watchNotes.
Actual Electron IME/font/focus/zoom/theme proof cannot be substituted by source inspection, fixture screenshots, toasts, green unit tests or validation of this report.
